// The source excerpts keep a stray closing or opening quote where a verse is
// cut out of speech; the band adds its own quotes, so drop the unmatched one.
const clean = (text: string): string => {
  const open = text.split('“').length - 1
  const close = text.split('”').length - 1

  if (close > open && text.endsWith('”')) {
    return text.slice(0, -1).trimEnd()
  }

  if (open > close && text.startsWith('“')) {
    return text.slice(1).trimStart()
  }

  return text
}

const current = atom({ plugin: 'session-verses', key: 'verse' } as const, null)

export const register: Register = on => {
  // One pick per session: a hot reload fires session.start again, so keep the pick.
  on('session.start', async ($, e, next) => {
    if ((await read($, current)) === null) {
      const n = new Uint32Array(1)
      crypto.getRandomValues(n)
      const [reference, text] = VERSES[n[0] % VERSES.length]
      const verse: Verse = { reference, text }
      await update($, current, () => verse)
    }

    return next(e)
  })

  // Beneath token-weather: whatever the hooks below draw goes first, the verse under it.
  on('ui.render', { component: 'AbovePrompt' }, async ($, e, next) => {
    const below = await next(e)
    const verse = await read($, current)

    if (e.props.hasSurvey || verse === null) {
      return below
    }

    const { Box, Text } = $.ui.resolve(e)
    const isTree = below && (below as { type?: string }).type === 'Box'

    return (
      <Box flexDirection="column">
        {isTree ? below : null}
        <Text dimColor italic>
          “{clean(verse.text)}” <Text bold>— {verse.reference}</Text>
        </Text>
      </Box>
    )
  })
}
